head_commit.message:
refactor(reorganization): integrate R09 and R10 under the union

Integrate the final two waves of the repository-reorganization completion phase.
The live ratchet reaches zero: 2,927 Lean modules, 0 unclassified, 0 mixed, 0
noncanonical names, 0 unsorted aggregate imports.

Both immutable delivery tips are preserved by separate true merges:
3de7b02333d7415664f440ceb6ad7ea899f32f57 (R09, tree
6586f131947aa0a31556cb2dce3bfa878f675aa6, 240 paths) at
7f30bb5d9d4ee134b436bbfb9214204da3315478, and
6be9f1100557c78f7187da99b269eb3767befba0 (R10, tree
69b531c7cb8c984a04f911f2a383ef1adc1465c5, 80 paths) at
256c9a742925400c592109a769a483a4ff6ad4b1. Both merges were automatic with zero
conflicts, because neither delivery contains an integrator-owned shared path.

This commit applies the reviewed 25-path R0012/R0013 common-base union exactly
once. Every postimage was materialized by replaying the union patch onto exact
C0006 code fda296b2079acae3bf1d3565b2dc6e45dc8f6ef5 in a temporary index and
verified byte-for-byte against
requests/R0012-R0013-union-postimages.tsv; 9 of the 25 paths are created here
because the deliveries do not carry them. B0011 and B0012 move active ->
delivered with their immutable delivery commits and hash-pinned report and scope
evidence.

An earlier delivery pair included the integrator-owned R0012/R0013 shared paths
and was rejected by check_phase.py's shared-path contract. Those commits were
superseded on the worker branches before anything reached main. Excluding the
shared paths is what makes the two waves disjoint on disk, which is why the
second merge went from four conflicts to none; the reviewed union is the single
place those files are reconciled, exactly as R07's delivery observes by
containing none of its 46 R0011 paths.

Both post-move-import-manifest ledgers are re-landed here. They had been derived
from a worker tree that still contained the integrator-owned edits, which
overstated the wave import surface: B0011 drops 1,687 -> 607 rows and B0012
1,204 -> 318. Control and delivery now agree byte-for-byte.

The reviewed tier amendment reviews/C0006-R09-R10-tier-amendment.md re-anchors
exactly one union row, docs/architecture/tiers.json. The integrated tree failed
generate_baseline.py --strict-source with 66 forbidden reusable-to-source
reachability pairs from 29 direct edges: thirteen wave destinations were tiered
reusable while importing DrineasMahoney RandNLA 2016 and Higham Chapter
04/23/26/28 material directly, so they are source-tied rather than reusable. The
amendment re-tiers those thirteen and withdraws one declared reusable entry
point, NumStability.Analysis.Probability, whose aggregate re-exports a re-tiered
child. Re-tiering alone was measured to stall at ten residual pairs, all from
that aggregate, which is not itself reusable-tiered and so cannot be moved; both
changes together converge to zero. Withdrawing the entry point is a real
reduction in the declared reusable surface and is disclosed as such in the
amendment, together with the alternative that would preserve it. The frozen
union patch and its patch_sha256 pin are left unmodified, and the other 24 union
postimages remain byte-exact, following the C0005 precedent
reviews/R0009-R0010-union-migration-amendment.md.

reviews/C0006-R09-R10-integration-authorization.json records the primary-human
grant, superseding both exclusions the activation control ecffb3860 carried
("R09 or R10 delivery" and "R09 or R10 integration") and preserving
self-acceptance, checkpoint acceptance and branch retirement. It also records
that both deliveries ship 16 of R07's 20 evidence artifacts and carry no
executable verification: all four checker scripts are withheld because the C0006
planned control never landed the branch sidecars and request artifacts they
read, so projection, request, scope and static replay are treated as NOT
PERFORMED. The integration relies instead on the recorded green gate
transcripts, the byte-exact postimage ledgers, and the union verification
performed here.

check_completion_phase.py gains the R09/R10 integration state: the delivery and
merge SHAs, the delivered B0011/B0012 record digests, the authorization digest,
an exact-shape validator for this single 32-path commit that also requires both
delivery tips to remain ancestors, a precommit allowance for the second true
merge, and the supersession of R07's terminal live-postimage ratchet by a
byte-exact check of the 25 union postimages. A later reviewed epoch supersedes
an earlier terminal ratchet, as R07's superseded C0004's, so the phase keeps a
live terminal ratchet rather than losing one.

Checkpoint acceptance, wave self-acceptance and branch retirement remain
outstanding; both branch records stand at delivered.
